'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a volunteer advisor who can be found during the morning, giving advises on curriculum to study in.

==Location==

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Reilynn:''' You have a knack for bionic materials. Why don't you come to the Engineering Department?
:'''Student:''' Professor... Truth be told... I want to go to the Agronomy Wing... I want to farm...
:'''Reilynn:''' That's fine as well. Whatever suits your interest.

==Dialogue==
;<nowiki>06:00-11:59</nowiki>
:'''Reilynn:''' Are you new to Rabelle College? My name is Reilynn. I'm a volunteer advisor in charge of sorting evaluations. Is there anything you'd like to ask me?
:{{DIcon}} What are sorting evaluations?
::'''Reilynn:''' You're already a Synchronist at Rabelle College. This assessment isn't for you. Let me explain...
:{{DIcon}} Do I have to be assessed? I'm a bit nervous...
::'''Reilynn:''' Nervous? But you're already a Synchronist! You were qualified during enrollment. There's no need for you to do this assessment.
:'''Reilynn:''' To help new students adapt to academic life, the Academy has updated its curriculum to include a two-year Preparatory Program that provides generalized learning.
:'''Reilynn:''' It gives everyone a chance to scope out the different departments and really think about what interests them.
:{{DIcon}} What if their scores are mediocre?
:'''Reilynn:''' Oh, don't worry. The sorting evaluation is just there to point you in a direction. What really matters is your overall performance and your own potential.
:'''Reilynn:''' Of course, if you've already got your eye on a department, going the extra mile in their related courses is a surefire way to boost your odds.
:{{DIcon}} Naturally.
:'''Reilynn:''' No need to worry. Look, everyone at Startorch Academy is... let's just say "special" in their own way. But anyone who makes the cut is built for a science career.
:'''Reilynn:''' We're all here because we chose this path, and we're all ready for the grind. Have a little faith in your peers.
{{Dialogue End}}
